name: Footwork Series
summary: Double-leg presses from the footbar through a run of foot positions. Big, simple movement that warms up the legs and lets you check everyone's alignment.
steps: Lie on the back with the heels on the footbar hip-width apart, arms long by the sides.
Breathe out to press the carriage away until the legs are straight.
Breathe in to bend the knees and bring the carriage home quietly.

layers.title: Toes, parallel
layers.text: Balls of the feet on the bar, heels lifted and still.

layers.title: Wide and turned out
layers.text: Feet wide on the bar, knees over toes.

layers.title: Pulses and holds
layers.text: Low, middle or top of the range.

layers.title: Tempo
layers.text: Three counts out, one count in.

layers.title: Add arms or a prop
layers.text: Arms off the carriage, ring or ball between the knees.

modifications: Take a spring off if the legs can't press with control.
Heels on the bar for sore ankles or knees.
Too heavy a spring can aggravate the shoulders against the shoulder rests.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.
Heels on the bar, smaller bend, soft knees at the top.

cues:
Pelvis and spine stay in neutral — nothing rocks.
Straight legs, not locked knees.
Knees track over the second toes.
Move the carriage with muscle, not momentum.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
